judgments.label: false_positive
judgments.rationale: Link "https://ggaging.com" ending the sentence "Acesse a GGA e conheça as pesquisas publicadas: https://ggaging.com" in the article body. The claim is true as a sentence: the link text is an address. But 2.4.4 does not forbid URLs as link text; it asks that the purpose be determinable from the link text together with its programmatically determined context. Here the same sentence states the purpose: go to the GGA journal and read its published research. The URL also names the journal's site (ggaging = Geriatrics, Gerontology and Aging, introduced at length in the article). The link meets 2.4.4. The checker applied a stricter rule (a URL is not a purpose) than the criterion requires. Same text on the live page.
